description: A song's lyrics, its context (the story and theology behind it), or its full info (lyrics, context, style and where to listen).

part.description: lyrics, context, or info for both and where to listen.

slug.description: A song slug, such as current.slug from attend, or one from browse.

name: read_song

context.description: Its context, when it has one: GET /api/music/{slug}/context.
The context, for context or info.

duration.description: Its length in seconds, or null where it is not known.

durationFormatted.description: Its length as minutes and seconds, e.g. 4:10.

links.description: /api/attend only (current song): its original music video (youtube), when it has one. suno is always null since 2026-10-24.

suno.description: Always null since 2026-10-24, kept as a field.

youtube.description: The song's original music video, where it has one.

lyrics.description: The lyrics, for lyrics or info.

next_steps.description: Suggested next actions, present in every response, errors included. A step with a "tool" field can be taken with that tool.

items.description: A natural follow-up the agent might take. `tool` names the MCP tool for the same step. A step may group several `steps`.

action.description: A short name for the step.

body.description: A request body to send, for POST steps.

description.description: What the step is and why an agent might take it.

hint.description: How to fill in the step, where it needs filling in.

note.description: Something to know before taking the step.

steps.description: Steps grouped under this one, each the same shape, a description where it needs one.

action.description: A short name for the step.

body.description: A request body to send, for POST steps.

description.description: What the step is and why an agent might take it.

hint.description: How to fill in the step, where it needs filling in.

note.description: Something to know before taking the step.

tool.description: The MCP tool that takes this step, when one does.
The MCP tool that takes this step, when one does.

recording.description: The song's audio on this site (audio/mpeg), or null for a song whose audio is not made yet.

slug.description: The song's slug: send it as songSlug when you reflect, or to read_song.

title: Read a song
